description: ABCD 数据集专属适配，按该数据集的命名、目录或表字段约定选择处理方法。支持：abcd 质控汇总；abcd 表型/刺激提取；abcd 复制整理为 BIDS 目录。

method_refs.label: abcd 质控汇总
method_refs.role: Generate per-subject QC summaries and exclusion lists for ABCD Study. Combines fMRIPrep confounds, FreeSurfer recon-all metrics, and ABCD native QC flags to produce a unified QC report with configurable exclusion criteria。 Inputs: fmriprep_dir: Path to fMRIPrep output directory (directory); freesurfer_dir: Path to FreeSurfer output directory (directory); raw_qc: Path to ABCD native QC file (e.g., abcd_imgincl01.csv) (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: abcd 表型/刺激提取
method_refs.role: Extract and merge ABCD Study phenotype tables for downstream analysis. Reads ABCD tab-delimited phenotype files, selects columns, aligns visits, and optionally cross-references with imaging subject lists。 Inputs: phenotype_dir: Directory containing ABCD phenotype CSV/TSV files (directory); imaging_ids: Path to BIDS participants.tsv or file with imaging subject IDs (file). Registered outputs: results/output.csv.

method_refs.label: abcd 复制整理为 BIDS 目录
method_refs.role: Reorganize ABCD Study raw data into BIDS-style directory structure. Handles NDAR-style subject IDs, ABCD event names, and multimodal routing for T1w, T2w, dMRI, rs-fMRI, and task-fMRI。 Inputs: input: Path to ABCD raw data directory (directory); participants_file: Optional: path to ABCD phenotype file for participant metadata (file). Registered outputs: results/.

name: abcd-skill
